definitions.explanation: A renowned, highly regarded painting recognized for its artistic value.
A film widely regarded as outstanding or a classic. Common in older or literary usage.

examples.japanese: {美術館|びじゅつかん}で{名画|めいが}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}する。
examples.english: Appreciate famous paintings at an art museum.

examples.japanese: この{名画|めいが}は{数億円|すうおくえん}の{価値|かち}がある。
examples.english: This famous painting is worth several hundred million yen.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}から{集|あつ}められた{名画|めいが}の{展覧会|てんらんかい}が{開|ひら}かれている。
examples.english: An exhibition of famous paintings gathered from around the world is being held.

examples.japanese: {名画座|めいがざ}で{昔|むかし}の{名画|めいが}を{楽|たの}しんだ。
examples.english: I enjoyed old classic films at a repertory cinema.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{名画|めいが}と{呼|よ}ばれる{映画|えいが}はほとんど{観|み}ている。
examples.english: He has seen almost all the films considered masterpieces.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {名|めい} (famous, renowned) and {画|が} (picture, painting). Can refer to either paintings or films depending on context. The painting sense is more common. {名画座|めいがざ} is a repertory cinema that screens classic films.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名画|めいが}を{鑑賞|かんしょう}する (to appreciate a famous painting)
- {名画|めいが}を{所蔵|しょぞう}する (to house famous paintings in a collection)
- {名画座|めいがざ} (repertory cinema)
